title: TIPOS EXTRA VYPLATA - pre-registration (agent_lab3)

split.rule: All hyper-parameters / rule choices are made using discovery data only (prequential walk-forward inside discovery, first 20 discovery draws used only as burn-in). They are frozen in agent_lab3/frozen.json BEFORE any holdout evaluation is run. Holdout evaluation is strict walk-forward: the prediction for holdout draw t uses only draws < t (discovery + earlier holdout draws), with frozen hyper-parameters.

metrics.primary_LL: mean over holdout draws of log P_model(drawn ORDER of 6 main numbers) - log P_uniform(order) = log P_model + log(27*26*25*24*23*22); nats per draw. (For the extra number: log P_model(pb) + log 7.)
metrics.secondary_LL: same with the unordered SET probability (sum over 720 orders), reported but not tested
metrics.bootstrap: 95% percentile CI of mean per-draw gain, 10000 bootstrap resamples of holdout draws
metrics.p_value_LL: one-sided Monte-Carlo p: holdout draws replaced by i.i.d. uniform random ordered draws (discovery kept real), identical walk-forward re-run; p = (1 + #{sim >= obs}) / (R + 1). Also reported: the always-valid e-value bound p_e = min(1, exp(-sum of holdout gains)).
metrics.top6_hits: top-6 numbers by model weight before each draw; total hits vs 84*36/27 = 112, z = (H - 112)/sqrt(84 * 0.83761) (exact hypergeometric variance per draw); one-sided p from the exact distribution (convolution of hypergeometrics).

hypotheses_family_AB_draw_predictability.holm: Holm-Bonferroni over the 9 primary p-values A1..A6, B1..B3 at family-wise alpha = 0.05
hypotheses_family_AB_draw_predictability.A1_PL_static: Plackett-Luce ball-propensity model on the drawn order, log-weights theta ~ N(0, s^2) MAP (Newton). s chosen on discovery from {0.02,0.05,0.1,0.15,0.2,0.3,0.5}. Primary test: holdout ordered-LL gain > 0 (MC p).
hypotheses_family_AB_draw_predictability.A2_PL_forgetting: Same PL with exponentially decaying draw weights, half-life h in {4,8,16,32,64} draws, s in the same grid; (h,s) chosen on discovery. Primary test: holdout ordered-LL gain > 0.
hypotheses_family_AB_draw_predictability.A3_PL_changepoint: Bayesian online change-point detection (Adams-MacKay) with constant hazard 1/H, H in {10,25,50,100,200}; within a segment the propensities are a Dirichlet(a)-count plug-in, PL weights w_i = a + c_i (c_i = count of i in the current run), a in {2,5,10,20,50}; predictive = run-length posterior mixture. (H,a) chosen on discovery. Primary test: holdout ordered-LL gain > 0.
hypotheses_family_AB_draw_predictability.A4_hot_numbers: Rule fixed on discovery: pick the 6 numbers with the most (mode=hot) or fewest (mode=cold) appearances in the last K draws, K in {3,5,8,10,15,20,30,40,60}; ties broken by count over all history (same direction), then by lower number. (mode,K) maximizing discovery walk-forward hits is frozen. Primary test: holdout top-6 hits > 112 (exact one-sided p).
hypotheses_family_AB_draw_predictability.A5_two_machine_HMM: Two-state hidden Markov mixture (two machines / ball sets), each state with its own PL propensity vector (MAP, s fixed at 0.3), stay-probability rho in {0.5 (iid mixture), 0.8, 0.95}, fitted by EM (5 restarts on discovery). rho chosen on discovery prequential LL. Holdout: forward-filtered state posterior x transition -> mixture of the two PL models; EM refit every 4 holdout draws with warm start. Primary test: holdout ordered-LL gain > 0 (MC p with R>=40 plus e-value bound).
hypotheses_family_AB_draw_predictability.A6_lag1_repeat: Numbers from the previous draw have a different probability of reappearing. Test: holdout total repeats vs 84*1.3333 (two-sided, exact hypergeometric convolution). Direction and size delta (PL weight multiplier exp(delta) for previous-draw numbers) estimated on discovery and reported.
hypotheses_family_AB_draw_predictability.B1_extra_drum_bias: Extra number (1..7) Dirichlet-multinomial predictive with concentration a in {1,2,5,10,20,50,200} and optional forgetting half-life in {16,32,64,inf}; chosen on discovery. Primary test: holdout LL gain > 0 (MC p).
hypotheses_family_AB_draw_predictability.B2_extra_lag1_repeat: P(pb_t == pb_{t-1}) > 1/7 in holdout (one-sided exact binomial; discovery showed excess).
hypotheses_family_AB_draw_predictability.B3_extra_cold_persists: The least-frequent extra number in discovery is drawn with frequency < 1/7 in holdout (one-sided exact binomial).

descriptive_not_in_holm.D1: Chi-square uniformity of main-number frequencies separately on discovery and holdout; chi-square homogeneity discovery vs holdout (2x27).
descriptive_not_in_holm.D2: Chi-square uniformity of extra number separately on discovery and holdout.
descriptive_not_in_holm.D3: Number 11 excess: discovery count vs holdout count of 11 (binomial vs 6/27).

hypotheses_family_C_popularity.C1_main_popularity: y_t = log(3-match winners_t / deposits_t). Ridge regression on 27 drawn-number indicators (shrunk toward a prior vector c*m, m = +1 for 3,5,7,8,9,13,19,21 and -1 for 1,16,18 from Slovak Loto 5z35, 0 otherwise), plus unpenalised: intercept, #consecutive pairs in draw, #numbers repeated from previous draw, Thursday indicator, Oct-2026 premium indicator, Mon+Thu era indicator, log(deposits). Ridge lambda and prior scale c chosen by leave-one-out CV on discovery. Holdout test: Pearson correlation between discovery-model number-effect prediction (sum of drawn-number coefficients) and holdout residual y (after regressing holdout y on the unpenalised covariates only), one-sided permutation p (permuting the 27 coefficients over numbers, 20000 perms).
hypotheses_family_C_popularity.C2_extra_popularity: Share of 3/4/5-match winners holding the drawn extra number estimates the fraction of players picking that extra number. Holdout test: correlation of per-extra-number popularity estimated on discovery vs on holdout > 0 (permutation p over the 7 labels, exact 5040 perms).

decision_rule_for_tickets: Two tickets, disjoint main numbers. If no hypothesis in family A/B survives Holm, choose main numbers minimising estimated popularity (full-data refit of the C1 model) subject to: disjoint, no run of 3+ consecutive numbers, no 3-term arithmetic progression within a ticket, avoid repeating last draw's numbers if the repeat coefficient is positive; extra numbers = the two least popular extra numbers (or the single least popular for both if its advantage is large). If a model survives, compute the expected-value trade-off: (model probability ratio for the ticket) x (popularity-driven prize share factor) and choose to maximise it.
